items.title: Avatar
items.description: A paralysed marine sent to the distant moon Pandora is torn between following orders and protecting the world he has come to call home.

items.title: Madagascar
items.description: Four pampered friends from a New York zoo end up stranded on a wild tropical island and have to figure out how to survive outside their cages.

items.title: Ice Age
items.description: An unlikely trio of prehistoric animals teams up to bring a lost human baby back to his family as the ice closes in.
